name: MCPJam included AI billed to a customer
description: PAGE · A usage row for an included (platform-paid) feature was written as a customer debit in the last 15 minutes. That customer is being charged for something MCPJam pays for.
TRIAGE — open View Query, replace the last line with:
then check the deployed PLATFORM_PAID_INTERNAL_LLM and that the route forwards billingMode
rationale: WHY THIS EXISTS: the whole program is 'included AI comes out of MCPJam's budget'. The failure that matters most is silent: a route that stops forwarding billingMode, or a feature dropped from the set, goes back to debiting customers and nothing else notices.

THE FEATURE LIST MIRRORS mcpjam-backend convex/lib/pricing/internalLlmPolicy.ts PLATFORM_PAID_INTERNAL_LLM (as of backend #1463). Adding a platform-paid feature there without adding it here leaves it unwatched; platform-lanes.test.mjs pins the list so the edit is deliberate.
WHY record_created ONLY: a cost update inherits the row's policy; watching creation catches the violation once.

SOURCE IS NEW: emitted by mcpjam-backend #1463 (lane events, usage funding) and #1470 (snapshot). Until both are in PROD this query returns no rows — an Above monitor stays silent and the deadman would page falsely. Apply only after the prod deploy, with --only <key>.
